# Promo Fee Basis Native Owners

`accounting-owners.json` contains read-only production function/view captures
from November 16, 2026. The native harness checks every original function's
`pg_get_functiondef` MD5 before applying the actual migration. The two small
SQL dependency files contain their own byte checks.

The actual cash plan, historical agreements, original source accrual,
commission insertion/guards, original tournament fee capture and certified
rakeback calculation/write/replay execute here. Minimal typed relations isolate
these owners. The certificate relation reuses the maintained production schema
fixture. Launch waiver, Diamond identification and unrelated own-agent wallet
destination routing are explicit fixture interfaces.

Tournament terminal recognition rows are typed opening fixtures; the real
recognized-source guard and payable view consume them. Wallet payout guards,
terminal bank recognition and actual chip payments are outside this test. The
proof creates no production session or financial intent.

`mtt-admission-guard.json` captures the real installed admission guard and its
private owner/ACL. The same native proof runs the protected migration applier's
stale-pin wrapper, reproduces rollback with the old fee pin, and verifies that
the corrected migration changes only that exact pin. It does not claim to run
the separate full MTT ABI activation and its complete dependency graph.
